title: The Previous owner of the shop
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：previous　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 previous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the postman wrote of ① a previous owner of the shop in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so previous that nobody in the office would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the previous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the previous owner of the shop that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for June 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too previous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the previous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a previous evening before the storm, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as previous as the evening before the storm they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was previous or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something previous, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite previous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the previous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, year after year, she wrote of another previous owner of the shop in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less previous than anybody had expected. ⑩ The previous evening before the storm that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the previous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 先前（前置定语 a previous owner of the shop：1965 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件先前的东家）
B. adj. 先前／以往（两处加强说法：so previous that … 与 no less previous than …）
C. adj. 先前／以往（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 先前（表语 too previous to do：母亲觉得它太先前，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 以往（前置定语 a previous evening before the storm：叔叔把整件事称作一桩以往的傍晚）
F. adj. 以往（同级比较 as previous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩风暴前一天的傍晚相比）
G. adj. 以往（后置定语 something previous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 以往（受程度副词修饰 quite previous：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a previous owner of the shop
the previous owner of the shop that
a previous evening before the storm
The previous evening before the storm that

answers.why: previous 意为“先前”，1965 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件先前的东家”，此处作前置定语 a previous owner of the shop。
previous 意为“先前”，此处用 so previous that 结构，说它先前到邮局里没人敢靠近。
previous 意为“先前”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的先前店铺先前的东家，等于最高级的说法。
previous 意为“先前”，母亲认为这件东西“太先前了，谁也用不上”，too previous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
previous 意为“以往”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩以往的傍晚”，此处作前置定语 a previous evening before the storm。
previous 意为“以往”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩风暴前一天的傍晚一样以往”，同级比较用 as previous as。
previous 意为“以往”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“以往的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something previous。
previous 意为“以往”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当以往”，quite 修饰原级 previous。
previous 意为“以往”，no less previous than 表示“其以往不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之以往不亚于任何人的预料。
previous 意为“以往”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的以往傍晚”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件先前的东家。（a previous owner of the shop）
它先前到邮局里没有一个人敢靠近。（so previous that …）
母亲觉得它太先前，谁也用不上。（too previous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩以往的傍晚。（a previous evening before the storm）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩风暴前一天的傍晚一样以往。（as previous as …）
到了 1972 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件以往的东西。（something previous）
answers: In 1965 the postman wrote of a previous owner of the shop in the list.
It was so previous that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too previous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a previous evening before the storm.
He said nobody would call it as previous as the evening before the storm they had once had.
By 1972 the list asked for nothing but something previous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 previous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the postman wrote of a previous owner of the shop in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the previous owner of the shop that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too previous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a previous evening before the storm, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite previous, and everybody laughed.
The previous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
